description: Explain a Levels.fyi compensation metric or concept (e.g. "TC" / total_compensation, base salary, total_cash, tc_first_year, vesting, sign_on, target_bonus) — its meaning, formula, and caveats. Pass an unknown metric to get the list of known ones. REQUIRED arguments: metric.

metric.description: Compensation metric or concept to explain, e.g. "TC", "total_compensation", "base", "vesting", "sign_on", "tc_first_year". Case/separator-insensitive.

name: get-metric-explanation
